gte.708235A0CFA41C29.quests.09D8C672BB49: How do I build a multiblock structure without instructions?
Hold down the U key on a multiblock host (such as an electric blast furnace) and select the multi-block structure information on the JEI page to obtain this multi-block
Then prepare the materials and place the main unit. Hold the handheld terminal and press Shift+right-click on the main unit. The multi-block structure will take shape.

Please note: There are many ways to build a multiblock structure. The automatically built multi-block structure may not be what you need. You may need to make minor adjustments, such as adding input and output silos.

Input bus, output bus, input assembly, output assembly, energy silo, maintenance silo. The same multiblock structure may have different levels, and different levels of multiblock structures may require different structure blocks. For more questions, please watch the tutorial video about GregTech Modern multiblock structures. The GregTechEasy team also welcomes new users to ask questions through various channels.

Using a voltage level that exceeds the required temperature of the recipe will cause the furnace temperature to rise. gte.tier_1_lv.quests.52D28804938B0A72.de: If you do not follow these safety instructions, there is a high probability that your machine and base will be destroyed in an explosion.
Rule 1: Do not light a fire near a machine; it will cause it to explode.
Second: Be sure to use cables of the correct specifications. For example, if your machine generates a total of 3A LV power, but you use 1x tin cable, your cable will catch fire.
Third: Pay attention to the input voltage of the machine.
If your machine inputs LV voltage, do not apply voltage above LV, otherwise the machine will explode immediately!
Additional information: Our GregTech machines are now waterproof and will not explode even if they are exposed to rain.
gte.tier_1_lv.quests.76E0E419612C082E.de: With the Wireless Network, you no longer have to worry about wiring your machines. For multi-block generators, use a Wireless Power Pod to send power to the Wireless Network.
For single block generators, use a Wireless Power Socket to receive power from single-block generators.

If a multiblock machine needs to be powered by a wireless network, use a wireless energy tank. For a single-block machine, For devices with this level, use a wireless energy receiver of the corresponding level.

A wireless energy receiver can also be attached to the device's casing. Please remember electrical safety and avoid attaching a high-level wireless energy receiver to a low-level device. This can cause a massive explosion.
